summary: Cyberpunk entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Cyberpunk 2077
entries.definitive_edition: Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition, or the Windows base game with Phantom Liberty installed and updated to the latest patch, is the practical definitive route.

emulation.notes: Use native Windows PC. Emulation is irrelevant for the primary route; cloud/console captures are only comparison material.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: High-end Windows PC with path tracing/Ray Tracing: Overdrive, Ray Reconstruction, HDR, and current patch support.

primary.version: Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition / base game plus Phantom Liberty, latest PC patch
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity and most complete route: the base game released first on Windows, and the Phantom Liberty/Ultimate bundle includes the expansion; PC also supports the full current patch line, Ray Tracing: Overdrive/path tracing, DLSS Ray Reconstruction, and scalable settings beyond console targets. Last-gen PS4/Xbox One and Stadia miss Phantom Liberty and later 2.x-era content support, while current consoles, Mac, and Switch 2 do not add exclusive story or mission content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows version updated to the latest patch, with Phantom Liberty installed. For best capture, use a high-end RTX PC, enable Ray Tracing: Overdrive/path tracing and Ray Reconstruction if performance allows, and document DLSS/upscaling, frame generation, HDR, mods, and patch number.

all_releases.fidelity: Top-fidelity native PC release with full patch support, Phantom Liberty, scalable graphics, Ray Tracing: Overdrive/path tracing, and DLSS Ray Reconstruction.
all_releases.reason: Primary because it is both the most complete supported route and the highest-fidelity platform when run on high-end hardware.

all_releases.fidelity: Last-generation console release; PS4 support ended after its November 8, 2022 patch, and PS5 is required for later patches and Phantom Liberty.
all_releases.reason: Skip because it lacks the current 2.x content/expansion support and is much lower fidelity than PC/current-gen routes, with no exclusive content sourced.

all_releases.fidelity: Last-generation console release; CD Projekt says new content after Patch 1.6 and Phantom Liberty are exclusive to PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.
all_releases.reason: Skip because it lacks Phantom Liberty/later update content and has no sourced exclusive content.

all_releases.fidelity: Cloud release of the base game; Stadia shut down and never received the later platform future.
all_releases.reason: Skip because the platform is discontinued and no exclusive game content was sourced.

all_releases.fidelity: Native current-gen console release with full 2.x-era support and Phantom Liberty availability.
all_releases.reason: Skip because it has no sourced exclusive missions, story, or modes versus PC; use only for console-performance comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Native current-gen console release with full 2.x-era support and Phantom Liberty; Ultimate Edition is Series-only because it contains content unavailable on Xbox One.
all_releases.reason: Skip because it has no sourced exclusive content versus PC, though it is a strong console fallback.

all_releases.fidelity: Ultimate Edition launch-window release including the base game and Phantom Liberty on Switch 2.
all_releases.reason: Skip for the main route because it is lower fidelity than high-end PC and adds no sourced exclusive story, missions, or modes.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Apple silicon Mac Ultimate Edition release, available through Mac App Store, GOG, Steam, and Epic.
all_releases.reason: Skip because it is a valuable native Mac port but does not exceed Windows PC fidelity or add exclusive game content.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC is both the fidelity and completeness pick. The only meaningful split is historical: PS4/Xbox One/Stadia represent launch-era preservation but lack Phantom Liberty and later content updates.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake/remaster. Ultimate Edition is a bundle of the base game plus Phantom Liberty, not a separate remake. Keep launch-era PS4/Xbox One/Stadia state separate if documenting the 2020 release history.
